_comment: One row per input of preview/action.yml. An input with NO row here is a
FAILURE in check 1o, not a skip — that is what stops this table
fossilising as controls are added, the way REMOVED_PLUGIN_TYPES and
target says which artifact must move:
blueprint  the diff must be non-empty AND touch only expect_paths
refusal    the probe value must be REFUSED, matching expect_error
expect_summary_contains asserts a LITERAL string reaches the summary. Needed
when the control is resolved before it is printed - `theme` prints
component@commit, never the coordinate typed - so expect_in_summary could
never match and the row would be unpinned.
expect_in_summary asserts the probe value reaches $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY.
That is the assertion that catches a gutted writeSummary, which once left

probes.note: Reaches the course name, which the reviewer reads in Moodle; it is not one of the facts the summary tabulates.
Reaches the course name, which the reviewer reads in Moodle; it is not one of the facts the summary tabulates.

expect_in_summary is VACUOUS for a one-digit probe and was measured to be: the baseline summary already contains "5" (MOODLE_500_STABLE) and "2" (&course=2&), so this row passed with writeSummary gutted - the exact bug the assertion exists to catch. Pin the sentence the summary actually prints instead.

Pin the sentence the summary actually prints instead.
Unobservable without a version.php under the probe root; the fixture supplies one.

Changes the step LIST: one installMoodlePlugin per plugin, so a second one appears. Pinned to a full commit rather than a branch so the probe needs no ref lookup, and to a real public repository because the coordinate is checked against reality — the commit, the archive and the version.php all have to be there. The summary prints the resolved component@commit, not the coordinate that was typed, so there is nothing to match in it.

Changes the step LIST three ways at once: the theme is installed like any other plugin, setTheme activates it, one runPhpCode proves it really is active before the reviewer arrives, and a second, non-critical one builds its stylesheet after login - split because a WASM heap abort in the compile would otherwise take the whole preview down. Pinned to a full commit rather than a branch so the probe needs no ref lookup, and to a real public repository because everything about the coordinate is checked against reality - the commit, the archive, version.php AND config.php's $THEME->parents all have to be there. boost_union deliberately: it sets parents in both arms of a Workplace check, which is the case the parse must warn about rather than refuse, so this row would fail if that branch were ever tightened. The summary prints the resolved component@commit, not the coordinate that was typed, so there is nothing to match in it.

data-hosts REPLACES the allowlist and only affects the gate, so a widening value changes no artifact at all. Narrowing it to exclude the plugin's own host is the one observable, deterministic proof that the env var reaches the gate.
Changes where the link points, not what the blueprint says. A blueprint diff would be the wrong assertion.

Changes the step LIST, not just field values: createCourse becomes restoreCourse and the post-restore assertion is inserted. Index-normalised field paths cannot express that — inserting a step makes every later step compare against a different one. Uses the users=0 fixture: a backup carrying student1 is refused, because createUsers would fail mid-boot.

A menu, resolved to the pinned sample-course address inside the builder, so the form never carries a long URL. Same shape change as restore-course-url because it feeds the same setting — that is deliberate: two names for one thing is how a menu and a box end up disagreeing.
